name: mosaic-apps
description: Mosaic - next-gen metadata-driven full-stack app platform (entities -> migrations -> auto CRUD -> drag & drop JSON forms) for JS/TS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-core && npm run build -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-server && npm run build -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-cli && npm run build -w studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-core && npm run typecheck -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-server && npm run typecheck -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-cli && npm run check -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-ui && npm run check -w studio
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-core && npm run test -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-server && npm run test -w @mosaic-apps/mosaic-ui
